sections.title: Listening Part 1 — Photographs
sections.instructions: For each question, choose the statement that best describes the photograph.

sections.title: Listening Part 2 — Question–Response
sections.instructions: Listen to the question and choose the best response.

sections.title: Listening Part 3 — Conversations
sections.instructions: Listen to the conversation and choose the best answer to each question.

sections.title: Listening Part 4 — Talks
sections.instructions: Listen to the talk and choose the best answer to each question.

sections.title: Reading Part 5 — Incomplete Sentences
sections.instructions: Choose the word or phrase that best completes the sentence.

sections.title: Reading Part 6 — Text Completion
sections.instructions: Choose the best word or phrase to fill the blank.

sections.title: Reading Part 7 — Reading Comprehension
sections.instructions: Read the passage and choose the best answer to each question.
